---
title: "🤼 Wrestler Rosters by School"
subtitle: "Explore collegiate programs and expand any school to view all affiliated athletes, weight classes, and tournament records."
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
💡 **Tip:** Click on any school row or dropdown arrow below to expand and view the full roster of athletes who competed for that program across national tournament years.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("_setup.R")

roster_clean <- roster_df |>
  filter(wrestler != "Baptist") |>
  mutate(
    wrestler = if_else(wrestler == "Asia", "Asia Ray", wrestler),
    school = if_else(wrestler == "Asia Ray", "Wayland Baptist", school),
    school_norm = map_to_geo(school),
    school_norm = case_when(
      grepl("^Life Pacific", school) ~ "Life Pacific University",
      is.na(school_norm) | school_norm %in% c("—", "", "Unknown") ~ "Unattached / Independent",
      TRUE ~ school_norm
    )
  )

schools_roster_summary <- roster_clean |>
  group_by(school_norm) |>
  summarize(
    total_athletes = n_distinct(wrestler),
    total_entries = n(),
    years_active = paste(sort(unique(year)), collapse = ", "),
    all_americans = sum(place != "Competitor"),
    champions = sum(grepl("1st", place)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(schools_geo |> select(school, state, city) |> distinct(), by = c("school_norm" = "school")) |>
  mutate(
    state = case_when(
      school_norm == "Life Pacific University" ~ "CA",
      school_norm == "Unattached / Independent" ~ "—",
      TRUE ~ replace_na(state, "—")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(school_norm == "Unattached / Independent", desc(total_athletes), school_norm)

reactable(
  schools_roster_summary,
  theme = tbl_theme,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 55),
  onClick = "expand",
  columns = list(
    school_norm = colDef(name = "Collegiate Program", minWidth = 200),
    state = colDef(name = "State", width = 85, align = "center", cell = badge_state),
    total_athletes = colDef(
      name = "Athletes",
      width = 110,
      align = "center",
      cell = \(v) tags$span(style = "font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a;", paste0(v, " wrestlers"))
    ),
    all_americans = colDef(name = "All-Americans", width = 130, align = "center", cell = badge_aa_count),
    champions = colDef(name = "National Titles", width = 130, align = "center", cell = badge_champ_count),
    years_active = colDef(name = "Years Competed", minWidth = 160),
    total_entries = colDef(show = FALSE),
    city = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  details = function(index) {
    sch_name <- schools_roster_summary$school_norm[index]
    athletes <- roster_clean |>
      filter(school_norm == sch_name) |>
      select(wrestler, year, weight_class, record, place) |>
      arrange(desc(year), weight_class, wrestler)
    
    div(
      style = "padding: 14px 20px; background: #f8fafc; border-left: 5px solid #1d4ed8; border-radius: 8px; margin: 6px 0; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);",
      div(
        style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px;",
        tags$h5(
          style = "margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a;",
          paste("🤼", sch_name, "— Roster of Athletes")
        ),
        tags$span(
          style = "font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b;",
          paste(nrow(athletes), "tournament entries across", n_distinct(athletes$wrestler), "athletes")
        )
      ),
      reactable(
        athletes,
        theme = tbl_theme,
        searchable = TRUE,
        compact = TRUE,
        bordered = TRUE,
        striped = TRUE,
        highlight = TRUE,
        defaultPageSize = 10,
        showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
        pageSizeOptions = c(5, 10, 20, 50),
        columns = list(
          wrestler = colDef(name = "Athlete", minWidth = 160, style = list(fontWeight = 600)),
          year = colDef(name = "Year", width = 85, align = "center"),
          weight_class = colDef(name = "Weight", width = 95, align = "center", cell = \(v) paste0(v, " lbs")),
          record = colDef(name = "Tournament Record", width = 130, align = "center"),
          place = colDef(name = "Tournament Finish", minWidth = 150, cell = badge_place)
        )
      )
    )
  }
)
```
